sloka: अमी पवन विक्षिप्ता विनन्दन्ती इव पादपाः ।षट्पदैः अनुकूजद्भिः वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु ॥४-१-१८॥
transliteration: amī pavana vikṣiptā vinandantī iva pādapāḥ ।ṣaṭpadaiḥ anukūjadbhiḥ vaneṣu madhu gandhiṣu ॥4-1-18॥

translations.english: As if the trees are singing, swayed by the wind, while the bees in the forest, fragrant with honey, hum in tune.
